description: Core infrastructure: add http + cached_network_image to pubspec, implement SchemaExtractor, BloggerDataService, LocationService, CartModels, CartManager, and ProductState. These are pure-logic or lightly-Flutter layers with no routing or feature UI — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 both depend on them.
steps: Step 1 — Add packages to pubspec.yaml. Under `dependencies:` add exactly two lines: `http: ^1.2.2` and `cached_network_image: ^3.4.1`. Run `flutter pub get` from c:\Users\manis\Desktop\apps\bholix. No other packages.

Step 2 — Create lib/core/schema/schema_extractor.dart. Top-level class SchemaExtractor (no constructor needed, all static methods). Methods:
  • `static dynamic getFirst(dynamic val)` — returns val[0] if val is List else val.
  • `static List<dynamic> getArray(dynamic val)` — returns val as List if already List, else [val].
  • `static Map<String,dynamic>? extractJsonLd(String html)` — regex `<script[^>]+type=["']application/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)</script>` (case-insensitive), get group(1), HTML-unescape (replace & < > " '), try json.decode, cast to Map<String,dynamic>, return null on any error.
  • `static Map<String,dynamic>? findMatchingVariant(Map parent, Map<String,String> selectedAttrs, String? lastClickedAttr)` — iterates `getArray(parent['hasVariant'])`, scores each variant's additionalProperty list against selectedAttrs (prioritising lastClickedAttr key), returns highest-score variant or null.
  • `static Map<String,dynamic> extractPrice(dynamic offer)` — unwraps offer list to single map, reads priceSpecification or price field, returns `{'price': double, 'currency': String}`.
  • `static String extractAvailability(dynamic offer)` — returns `offer['availability'] as String? ?? ''`.
  • `static Map<String,dynamic> extractEligibleQuantity(Map data)` — reads data['eligibleQuantity'] map, returns `{'minValue': int, 'maxValue': int}`.
  • `static int? extractInventoryLevel(Map data)` — reads data['inventoryLevel']?['value'] as int.
  • `static String normalizeName(String name)` — name.trim().toLowerCase().
  • `static List<Map<String,dynamic>> findAllServices(dynamic obj)` — recursive walk: if obj is Map check 'hasOfferCatalog' and 'addOn' keys, if List recurse each item, collect all maps whose @type contains 'Service'.
  • `static Map<String,dynamic>? findMatchingServicePackage(Map parent, String packageName)` — walks parent['hasOfferCatalog'] list, finds entry where normalizeName(entry['name']) == normalizeName(packageName).

Step 3 — Create lib/core/services/blogger_service.dart. Define `const kBlogBaseUrl = 'https://demo.blogspot.com'` at top. Class `BloggerDataService` with:
  • Private `final http.Client _client`; constructor `BloggerDataService({http.Client? client}) : _client = client ?? http.Client()`.
  • `Future<List<Map<String,dynamic>>> fetchFeedData({int maxResults = 10, int startIndex = 1, String? label, String? searchQuery})` — builds URL `$kBlogBaseUrl/feeds/posts/default?alt=json&max-results=$maxResults&start-index=$startIndex` appending `&q=label:$label` or `&q=$searchQuery` when provided. GET with _client, parse body as JSON, return `(decoded['feed']['entry'] as List).cast<Map<String,dynamic>>()`; return [] on any error.
  • `Map<String,dynamic>? extractSchemaFromEntry(Map<String,dynamic> entry)` — gets content from `entry['content']?['\$t'] as String? ?? ''`, calls `SchemaExtractor.extractJsonLd(content)`.
  Imports: dart:convert, package:http/http.dart as http, ../schema/schema_extractor.dart.

Step 4 — Create lib/core/services/location_service.dart. Class `LocationService` (non-singleton, instantiate where needed).
  • Fields: `double? latitude`, `double? longitude`, `String? pinCode`, `String? city`.
  • `Future<void> saveLocation({double? lat, double? lon, String? pin, String? city})` — saves JSON to a file antinna_location.json in `(await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory()).path`. Updates in-memory fields.
  • `Future<void> loadLocation()` — reads the file if it exists, populates fields from JSON.
  • `String formatLocationQuery()` — returns `'$pinCode $city'.trim()` or ''.
  Note: reverseGeocode is a stub that returns void and logs 'reverseGeocode not implemented' to debugPrint — no HTTP call needed yet.
  Imports: dart:convert, dart:io, package:path_provider/path_provider.dart, package:flutter/foundation.dart (for debugPrint).

Step 5 — Create lib/core/cart/cart_models.dart. Pure Dart, no Flutter imports.
  `class CartAddon { final String name; final String? description; final double price; final String currency; const CartAddon({required this.name, this.description, required this.price, required this.currency}); factory CartAddon.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic> j) => CartAddon(name: j['name'], description: j['description'], price: (j['price'] as num).toDouble(), currency: j['currency']); Map<String,dynamic> toJson() => {'name': name, 'description': description, 'price': price, 'currency': currency}; }`
  `class CartItem { final String id; final String title; final String? imageUrl; final double price; final String currency; int quantity; final List<CartAddon> addons; CartItem({required this.id, required this.title, this.imageUrl, required this.price, required this.currency, this.quantity = 1, List<CartAddon>? addons}) : addons = addons ?? []; double get totalPrice => (price + addons.fold(0.0, (s, a) => s + a.price)) * quantity; factory CartItem.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic> j) => CartItem(id: j['id'], title: j['title'], imageUrl: j['imageUrl'], price: (j['price'] as num).toDouble(), currency: j['currency'], quantity: j['quantity'] as int, addons: (j['addons'] as List).map((a) => CartAddon.fromJson(a as Map<String,dynamic>)).toList()); Map<String,dynamic> toJson() => {'id': id, 'title': title, 'imageUrl': imageUrl, 'price': price, 'currency': currency, 'quantity': quantity, 'addons': addons.map((a) => a.toJson()).toList()}; }`
  `class CartOrder { final List<CartItem> items; const CartOrder({required this.items}); const CartOrder.empty() : items = const []; factory CartOrder.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic> j) => CartOrder(items: (j['items'] as List).map((i) => CartItem.fromJson(i as Map<String,dynamic>)).toList()); Map<String,dynamic> toJson() => {'items': items.map((i) => i.toJson()).toList()}; }`

Step 6 — Create lib/core/cart/cart_manager.dart. Class `CartManager` as application singleton (static `CartManager get instance => _instance` with `static final _instance = CartManager._()`).
  • Uses `Signal<CartOrder> cartSignal = signal(const CartOrder.empty())` from signals_core.
  • `CartOrder get _order => cartSignal.value;`
  • `void addItem(CartItem item)` — if item.id already in _order.items, increment quantity; else add item. Reassign `cartSignal.value = CartOrder(items: [...])`. Then save.
  • `void removeItem(String id)` — filter, reassign, save.
  • `void updateQuantity(String id, int qty)` — update item quantity (min 1), if qty<=0 call removeItem; addons stay proportional (their per-unit prices are already unit-based, just quantity scales totalPrice). Reassign, save.
  • `void addAddonToItem(String itemId, CartAddon addon)` — find item, add addon to its addons list if not already present by name, reassign, save.
  • `void clearCart()` — cartSignal.value = const CartOrder.empty(); save.
  • `Future<void> load()` — reads bholix_cart.json from documents dir, deserializes CartOrder, sets cartSignal.value. Silent on missing file.
  • `Future<void> save()` — writes bholix_cart.json to documents dir.
  • `int get totalItems => _order.items.fold(0, (s, i) => s + i.quantity);`
  • `double get totalPrice => _order.items.fold(0.0, (s, i) => s + i.totalPrice);`
  • `void refreshCart()` — cartSignal.value = CartOrder(items: List.of(_order.items));
  Imports: dart:convert, dart:io, package:path_provider/path_provider.dart, package:signals_core/signals_core.dart, cart_models.dart.

Step 7 — Create lib/features/product/product_state.dart. Class `ProductState` as application singleton.
  • `static final ProductState instance = ProductState._();`
  • `final Signal<Map<String,String>> selectedVariants = signal({});`
  • `final Signal<int> quantity = signal(1);`
  • `final Signal<String?> selectedPackage = signal(null);`
  • `final Signal<Map<String,dynamic>?> currentSchema = signal(null);`
  • `void reset()` — resets all signals to initial values.
  Imports: package:signals_core/signals_core.dart only.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter analyze` reports zero errors after all steps.
SchemaExtractor.extractJsonLd correctly parses a JSON-LD script tag string (verifiable via unit test or manual check).
CartManager.addItem increases totalItems; removeItem decreases it.
ProductState.instance is the same object on two consecutive calls.

lib/core/schema/schema_extractor.dart, lib/core/services/blogger_service.dart, lib/core/services/location_service.dart, lib/core/cart/cart_models.dart, lib/core/cart/cart_manager.dart, lib/features/product/product_state.dart all exist and are importable.
